AppAction.description: One of an app's tools, and what Ghost's own permissions say about it.

conditional.description: A rule with argument patterns may decide some calls.

description.description: The app's, first sentence: untrusted text, shown to the operator only.

reads.description: Read-only, by the app's own word; anything else is a change.

rule.description: The rule that names just this tool ("github.issue_write").

AppConnect.description:
Connect an app: from the catalog (`catalog` and `option`), from a URL, or from another
client's pasted config. Secret values go to Ghost's vault, never into apps.json, and
never come back out.

problems.description: What the operator should know about a pasted config: keys Ghost does not read.

AppView.description: A connected app: how it is reached, whether it is up, and what it can do.

catalog.description: The catalog entry it came from.

name.description: Its short name: the rules' and the tools' prefix.

problem.description: Not connected, or tools not offered, and why; never a secret.

settings.description: The environment names it needs (secret values never shown).

AppsEvent.description:
An app was connected, disconnected or changed state: read `GET /apps`. With
`sign_in_url`, the app is waiting for the operator to sign in there; the desktop opens
it in the browser.

conversation.description: The agent it was proposed with (ADR 0014); colours the entry.

source.description: An app, or Ghost's own (conversations, skills, ...).

Build.description:
Which kind of build the running daemon is (docs/releasing.md): `dev` runs from a
checkout, `deploy` from a `make deploy` runtime, `release` from the bundle. The commit
is the full hash when known; `dirty` is a checkout that had uncommitted changes when
the daemon started. `launcher` is how a checkout's daemon was started, when the make
target says so (`GHOST_LAUNCHER`).

CatalogEntryView.description:
An app in the catalog. Its text is the registry's: shown to the operator, never to the
model.

connected.description: The names it is connected under already.

others.description:
In search results: other publishers' entries for the same product, folded under
the maker's own. Always empty on `GET /catalog/{name}`.

suggested_name.description: The short name it would be connected under.

CatalogMaker.description: The entry is the product maker's own, and what agreed.

CatalogOption.description:
One way to connect: sign in, an API key, or run on this computer. Where it runs: a
remote's `host`, and whose host that is; a package's `registry` and name.

host.description: A remote's host: what Ghost sends the app goes there.

host_owner.description: The product maker's host, the publisher's own, or someone else's.

total.description: Results, counting a maker's own with what folds under it as one.

CatalogPublisher.description:
Who published an entry, as the registry checked it. Who published it, not whether it
is safe.

seed_from.description:
Slug of a retired agent whose memory.md becomes this one's first memory, as a
handoff. Never Ghost.

ConversationEvent.description: The session moved to another conversation, or one was created, changed or removed.

ConversationUpdate.description:
Each field present is applied as its own audited write. `voice` "" means back to
Ghost's voice.

ConversationView.description: An agent (ADR 0014, ADR 0035): a conversation with a persona and a job.

active.description: The running session is with it.

own_voice.description: True when the voice is the agent's own.

retired_at.description: Set: off the roster and voice routing, still readable.

voice.description: The voice heard: its own, else Ghost's.

HTTPValidationError.description: The 422 body: a list of what was wrong.

HookInfo.description:
A webhook in hooks.json (ADR 0027, ADR 0035): on or off, and what came of deliveries
since the daemon started. Counts only; never a body.

path.description: POST here on the webhook listener.

ModelConnectionView.description: The model connection now. No key is in it: only whether its Password is set.

base_url_override.description: Set when it isn't the provider's own.

legacy.description: The older setting it comes from ("GHOST_LLM_ENDPOINT=openrouter").

model.description: As saved; "" means the provider's default.

sign_in_error.description: The last sign-in didn't go through.

sign_in_pending.description: OpenRouter is waiting for the browser.

values.description: The GHOST_LLM_* values that say this connection explicitly.

ModelDraft.description:
A connection being edited: GHOST_LLM_* values over the saved ones (None removes one),
and a key typed but not saved yet, used for this one request and dropped.

default.description: The provider's default, when it lists it.

error.description: Why the list couldn't be read; models is empty then.

ModelProviderView.description: One way to reach a model, as the Model page offers it.

base_url.description: "" for a URL of the operator's own.

default_model.description: None: the first the provider lists.

password.description: The Password's name it uses by default.

sign_in.description: OpenRouter: signing in gives the key.

url.description: The desktop opens it; the loopback takes the browser's way back.

ModelTestResult.description: One tiny request, timed like `make perf-llm`: request to first token.

answered_by.description: What the provider said answered, when it says.

where.description: Provider, protocol and host; never a key.

autonomy.description: By name alone; a rule with argument patterns may decide some calls.

OutputInfo.description: A file Ghost made in its out/ folder (ADR 0033). Ghost never runs it.

kept.description: Already in the vault; left as they were.

ghost.description: One Ghost itself reads; a new value applies at its next start.

last_used.description: The last time Ghost filled it in.

set.description: In the vault; None while the vault is closed (locked): unknown.

restart_required.description: Ghost's own: the service must restart to use it.

PasswordSet.description: Write-only; never echoed, not even in a validation error.

importable.description: What an import would take; empty after one.

PendingEvent.description: `pending` None when it was resolved or cancelled.

source.description: What it changes: an app, or Ghost's own (a `ToolSource` name).

PermissionsUpdate.description: Whole lists, the mode, or one rule moved; what is not given is kept.

PermissionsView.description: `[permissions]` in policy.toml: everything runs unless a rule says otherwise.

Phase.description: Where the daemon is. The tray tooltip and the phone's Home read it.

PhoneAddress.description: One `GHOST_PHONE_LISTEN` address and the network it is on.

listening.description: Bound now; a tunnel address whose interface isn't up yet is retried.

network.description:
None when Ghost can't tell: the address is on every interface (0.0.0.0), or on
none of this computer's right now.

oneOf.description:
The network a phone address is on (ADR 0020): the home network, or the operator's
WireGuard tunnel for away from home.

last_address.description: The listen address that request came in on.

last_network.description: And the network it came over.

oneOf.description:
The network a phone address is on (ADR 0020): the home network, or the operator's
WireGuard tunnel for away from home.

PhonePairing.description: A fresh pairing code for the phone listener. Shown to the operator only.

address.description: The first GHOST_PHONE_LISTEN address, host:port; what the operator types.

link.description: The QR code's payload: ghost://pair?code=…&address=…, every address in order.

address.description: None when the listener is off.

PolicyUpdate.description:
Either the raw TOML, or the routes rendered into it (the permissions have their own
route, `PUT /permissions`).

RoutesView.description: `[routes]` in the policy file (ADR 0031): how Ghost reaches the operator.

available.description:
The routes this daemon has something behind; the others can be listed but do
nothing yet.

RuleAdd.description: A rule appended to Ghost's AGENTS.md, verbatim (ADR 0035).

RuleSet.description: One toggle: move `rule` into `level`'s list, or out of every list (None).

RulesView.description: Ghost's AGENTS.md (ADR 0035): the rules in every agent's prompt.

conversation.description: With no session running, the line the new one opens in; Ghost when unset.

applied.description: Keys the daemon picked up without a restart.

restart_required.description: A pending value or a secret: the service must restart.

SettingsUpdate.description:
`values`: a None value deletes the key. `secrets`: write-only, into the vault (ADR
0036); None deletes.

secrets.description: Ghost's own passwords and the apps', set or not (ADR 0036); /passwords has the rest.

values.description: Non-secret settings, as written in settings.env.

path.description: A folder on this machine holding SKILL.md.

body.description: SKILL.md without its front matter, trimmed.

script.description: A file an interpreter runs, or one that was executable upstream.

SkillInfo.description: A skill Ghost can read (ADR 0023): a SKILL.md folder, Ghost's own or the operator's.

source.description: "ghost" for Ghost's own folder, "home" for the operator's ~/.agents/skills.

SkillListing.description:
A skill skills.sh lists (#35). Its text is the directory's: shown to the operator,
never to the model.

SkillOriginView.description: Where one of Ghost's skills was installed from (#35), as its lock file records it.

SkillPreview.description:
A skill fetched from GitHub and staged, for the operator to read before installing.
Everything in it but the hashes is the source's text: untrusted.

scripts.description: The ones ghost-scripts could run, through the gate.

skill_md.description: The whole SKILL.md, front matter included.

token.description: What install takes; good for 30 minutes.

source.description: owner/repo, owner/repo/skill, or a github.com address of a skill's folder.

SkillUpdateView.description: Whether an installed skill's source has moved on, checked when the page asks.

SourceInfo.description: A source of tools the gate knows: Ghost's own (built in) or a connected app.

conversation.description: Slug of the agent the session is with (ADR 0014).

ending.description: Ghost has decided to hang up: its goodbye may still be playing.

oneOf.description:
Where a live session's audio is: the desk's mic and speaker, or the paired phone over
WebRTC (ADR 0016).

version.description: YYYY.M.N, the same in every copy (`scripts/version.py`).

waiting.description: Items on the waiting list the operator has still to hear (ADR 0029).

ValidationError.description: One thing wrong with a request, as FastAPI says it: the kind, where, and why.

input.description: pydantic's extra, never filled: Ghost's 422 says where and why only (ADR 0036).

VaultView.description: Ghost's vault: one encrypted file, its key in the operator's keyring.

problem.description: Why it isn't open, in the operator's words.

WaitingEvent.description: The waiting list changed: read `GET /waiting` for it.

WaitingItemView.description:
One item that needs the operator. `title` comes from an outside system: show it as
text, never as markup. `change` is set for a change waiting for a yes.

count.description: How many still need the operator to hear them.

conversation.description: The line the session opens in; Ghost when unset.

text.description: Words to treat as the first turn.

WatchInfo.description: A watch in watches.json (ADR 0028, ADR 0035) and how its last look went.

WatchingView.description:
What Ghost watches (ADR 0035): the watches, the webhooks, where the webhook listener
is, and what is wrong in those files or left in Ghost's folder from an older layout.

listening.description: The webhook listener's addresses; empty when it is off.

info.description: Local control surface for ghostd over a Unix socket. Desktop and mobile apps talk to this; the model never does. Events stream over /events.
info.title: Ghost control API

get.description: Every app in apps.json: connected or not, and what each tool may do.

post.description:
Connect an app now and keep it in apps.json. An app that signs in comes back
with the address the browser should open; the desktop opens it.

delete.description:
Disconnect: it leaves the tools at once and apps.json; its sign-in and the keys
Ghost kept for it are forgotten.

post.description: Sign in again, or reconnect an app that isn't connected.

get.description: Proposals, newest first; source narrows to one app or one of Ghost's own.

Apps to connect, from Ghost's copy of the registry; first-party ones first when
nothing is searched. An old copy is refreshed in the background.

Every agent, Ghost first, retired ones included (``retired_at`` set) so the app
can show its Retired group. ``retired=true`` or ``false`` filters.

post.description: Retire the agent: off the roster and voice routing, everything kept.

get.description: Documents the payloads sent on the /events WebSocket. Not meant to be called.

schema.description: What the event stream carries, discriminated by `type`.

get.description: The model connection now, with every provider the page offers.

post.description:
The models a provider offers, for the saved connection or the one being edited.
A provider that can't be read says why; that is not an HTTP error.

Sign in to OpenRouter (OAuth with PKCE). The desktop opens the address; the
browser comes back to Ghost's loopback, and the key OpenRouter gives is kept as
the OPENROUTER_API_KEY password in Ghost's vault (ADR 0036). Nothing to copy.

Send one tiny request through the connection being edited and time its first
token, the way ``make perf-llm`` does.

get.description: The files Ghost made in its out/ folder (ADR 0033), by name.

post.description:
Once: heka-vault and the plaintext env files into the vault, then the plaintext
copies removed. A password already in the vault is kept.

Ask the keyring to unlock (it shows its own prompt on the desktop), then open
the vault. The daemon follows: Ghost's own settings and the apps that waited.

put.description: Save or replace one. The value is never returned, here or anywhere.

Change the mode, whole lists, or one rule; only ``[permissions]`` in the file is
rewritten, and the gate follows at once.

delete.description: Forget the paired phone; its signatures stop working at once.

post.description:
A new six-digit code for the phone, good for two minutes and five tries. It
replaces any earlier code. 409 when GHOST_PHONE_LISTEN is off.
A Confirm on a change on the waiting list (ADR 0030): the stale check runs.

get.description: Ghost's AGENTS.md: the rules in every agent's prompt (ADR 0035).

post.description:
Append a rule to Ghost's AGENTS.md, verbatim, through the gate: the operator's
own click, audited like the spoken ``rules.add`` (ADR 0035). Never written here.

get.description:
Skills on skills.sh for a search of two letters or more, from Ghost's cache when
recent. A failure is ``problem``, with the last results for the search if any.

post.description:
Copy a staged skill into Ghost's skills through the gate (``skills.install``),
audited, with where it came from.

Fetch a skill's folder from GitHub at the commit its branch is on, and stage it:
its SKILL.md and its files, for the operator to read before installing.

get.description:
For each skill Ghost installed from GitHub, whether its folder has changed at the
source since. Asks GitHub now (a recent answer per repository is reused).

post.description:
The newer version of an installed skill, staged like any preview; installing it
with ``replace`` and this name updates the skill.

The operator heard it: it stops alerting until it changes. Not a gate write;
it changes Ghost's own bookkeeping only.

get.description:
The watches in watches.json and the webhooks in hooks.json, each with its last
look and its counts, re-read now; where the webhook listener is; and what is wrong
in those files or left over in Ghost's folder (ADR 0035).
